question: Guru Bipin Singh was known for which classical dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipuri.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Guru Bipin Singh was a** manipuri dance director, choreographer, and instructor.**
 
• In **1966**, he received the** Sangeet Natak Akademi Prize.**
 
• Moreover, the government of Madhya Pradesh gave him the** Kalidas Samman.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak:**

 
 
• One of the** eight primary styles of Indian classical dance** is kathak.
 
• It is an **Uttar Pradeshi** classical dance style.
 
 
 
• **Bihu:**
 
 
• **The Bohag Bihu celebration **is **Assam's national event** and marks the beginning of the **Assamese New Year.**
 
• The Bihu dance honors and imitates the** seasonal mood, honoring fertility **and passion.
 
• The celebration takes place in the **middle of April.**
 
 
 
• **Kathakali:**
 
 
• **Kerala** is the region of **southwest India **where kathakali originated.
 
• The dance kathakali is a form of religion, like **bharatanatyam**.
 
• The Ramayana and tales from** Shaiva traditions** serve as its primary sources of inspiration.
